title: Norway’s Tormod Frostad wins men’s freeski big air on last jump in thrilling final
content:
LIVIGNO, Italy — As the snow fell under the lights in Livigno, Norway’s Tormod Frostad excelled in a men’s freeski big air final that was high on quality despite the conditions. He secured gold with 98.50 points on the final jump of the evening.

This is a breaking news story. More to follow.
